entries.title: 0025 — Provisional Freshness-Governance Qualification (Clinical-Adjacent Input Unavailable)
entries.role: The qualification that makes DR-W5-02 writable. entries.title: 0027 — Safety-Relevant Set Reconciliation and Freshness Coverage
entries.role: The reconciliation that lifts the block on DR-W5-02. Four accepted sources use high-stakes and safety-relevant vocabulary with four different memberships: W0 section 7's five-member individual-confirmation set at approval, W1-D3 section 6.3's four-member room-consumption set within section 6's own E6 and E7 scope, ADR 0002's six-member surfacing-ladder set, and W1-D3 section 10.7's re-authentication list, which remains an open question and is not an accepted fourth authority. This record establishes that the sets are scoped by governance function and are non-transferable, that membership of one never implies membership of another, and that no canonical universal safety-relevant set exists or is created. It adjudicates no membership: ADR 0002's six are neither validated nor re-justified, and ADR 0026 is not read as having settled them. It also withdraws an earlier reading that ADR 0002's Kitchen and Gym per-case row delegated the whole room layer to section 6.3, since the row names two rooms, section 6 is itself scoped to E6 and E7, and ADR 0002 cites section 6.3 for most-protective framing at L3 over its own six-member set. The record further reports, without closing, that pregnancy status and clinician instructions are in no accepted freshness taxonomy and so can never become review-due, stale or expired through ageing, and that freshness data type has no accepted definition anywhere in the corpus; neither item is mapped into condition, preference or any existing category. DR-W5-02 owns the composition question, freshness coverage, and the definition of freshness data type. Publication and independent remote verification of this record lift the block on DR-W5-02. An ADR 0002 L3 acknowledgement remains not a renewal and resets no freshness clock, and ADR 0025 safeguard 14 is untouched. Not a W5 deliverable and creating no W5 planning slot. Amends no law and no record, resolves W1-D3 section 10.6 and section 10.7 not at all, and authorises no implementation, directory, dependency, model contact, payload, transmission, harness or fixture execution.

entries.title: 0029 — Runtime Freshness and Unknown/Stale Behaviour (DR-W5-02)
entries.role: Establishes W5 runtime freshness and unknown/stale behaviour doctrine, the second of the seven W5-D1 doctrine records. Part A fixes freshness semantics: a freshness data type is a governance policy key, not a clinical taxonomy, not a sensitivity class, not a substitute for W1-D1's category inventory and implying no safety-set membership; there is one key shape only, carrying normative R, G and H with S = R + G derived and never governed independently; no per-field override exists; the unit is the fixed-duration day of exactly 24 elapsed hours; and seven governed policy keys are closed by this record — medication, allergy, condition, injury, pregnancy status, clinician instructions and preference. Every threshold value is a provisional governance default — not clinically validated, carried wherever a value is reproduced or summarised, and representations drawn from the six equal keys additionally carry the non-equivalence rule that their equality is a uniform provisional governance simplification and not evidence of clinical equivalence; the published chain permits provisional threshold-setting but validates no specific number. A governance review horizon falls at W5 closure or six months after acceptance, whichever comes first, and is never a clinical cadence; provisional status ends only by supersession or explicit re-affirmation, never by silence. Freshness must be valid at every governed reliance, evaluated at minimum before the first governed reliance in each relevant user-initiated interaction, with no background polling and all five W1-D3 section 7 triggers retained; acknowledgement is surfacing only and never renewal, writing no review timestamp and changing no freshness, authority, provenance, contradiction, supersession or pending-review state. Part B fixes runtime consequence: expired is retained as the freshness label while the assertion is consumed as unknown, with last-known assertion, provenance and age retained; a bounded unknown never means absence, resolution or reassurance; safeguard 14 is predicate-based rather than label-based and a stale item can meet the predicate; a fail-closed withholds only the dependent operation or output, never gating the person and never closing the room, with independent room operations remaining available; three assertion postures — positive safety constraint, ordinary positive fact and explicit absence assertion — are derived at evaluation from claim polarity, current authority and freshness treatment, and applicable scoped-set membership, and are never persisted; and ADR 0002's surfacing ladder and ADR 0020's always-shown inline mechanism apply independently within their own scoped memberships, with no precedence, no supersession, no winning set and no inferred fallback rule for non-members. W1-D3 section 10.1 and section 10.6 are resolved in the body, section 10.6 at the dependent-operation and output boundary with its own constitutional check, while the historical room-contract Open (section 10.6) text is not edited, superseded or amended and remains source text until a separately governed documentation update. Deterministic obligations for W5-D2 are separated from behavioural proof, which is deferred to DR-W5-07 and W5-D3 to W5-D4 and is not claimed here. Authorises no implementation, runtime directory, software/package dependency, model contact, payload construction, transmission, harness or fixture execution.

entries.title: 0030 — Grant Machinery, Consent Duration and Re-authentication (DR-W5-03)
entries.role: Defines lawful grant construction, grant lifecycle, consent duration and re-authentication for W5 runtime, the third of the seven W5-D1 doctrine records. It resolves in body W1-D2 section 8.1 (consent duration defaults) and W1-D2 section 8.2 with W1-D3 section 10.7 (re-authentication for high-stakes grants), whose posture W5-AR records as proposed and never decided after W1-D5 placed authentication flows out of scope. Part A makes W1-D2's grammar structurally normative: a grant is constructable only with all thirteen required elements over one already-declared W1-D1 edge, and a missing element, an undeclared edge, a blanket scope, or multiple independent edges or purposes make it unconstructable; a grant is an immutable delegation that can never create an edge, establish truth, refresh information, raise authority, transfer or delegate itself, widen itself, mutate, silently reactivate or become ambient permission. The lifecycle is proposed, declined, active, awaiting required re-authentication, review-due, expired and revoked; no freshness vocabulary is used for grants and stale is barred, W1-D2's inherited stale-grant wording being reported rather than reproduced and W1-D2 not amended; suspended is deliberately omitted for want of a distinct source-grounded meaning; and review-due is a surfacing state only, never shortening the governed validity interval nor making an active grant unusable before expiry. Re-affirmation never extends or renews a grant in place because duration is a governed element: it creates a successor grant with a new identity, a new validity interval and an inspectable predecessor lineage, the predecessor keeping its original scope and history; a successor grant is new permission arising from new explicit consent, not resurrection, and neither an expired nor a revoked grant ever reactivates. Material change to edge, actor, recipient or processing class, data class or scope, source or destination zone, purpose, operation, plaintext status, vendor involvement, or duration where it would alter the delegation requires a newly constructed grant rather than mutation. Part B fixes durations: Vault extraction single-task only with fresh re-authentication at grant time, profile scoped read standing with a maximum validity of 180 days as a hard ceiling after which the grant expires and silence neither renews it nor creates a successor, AI processing single-task default and session maximum, vendor disclosure per transmission, export preparation single-task, and no unbounded duration. A session is a narrow user-initiated active authority window that cannot silently revive; inactivity-based termination is non-operative until a later governed decision supplies a numeric threshold, and no implementation may supply that number by discretion. Re-authentication proves only present user control for the exact grant proposal being activated, in a fixed order of construct, make inspectable, re-authenticate, confirm consent, activate; it creates no consent, scope, edge, duration or permission, never becomes a reusable ambient recently-authenticated flag, and any material change after it invalidates that activation path. Vendor-hosted C3 and C4 plaintext disclosure carries a conditional re-authentication requirement only, and this record authorises no such path. Part C makes the runtime consequence structural: where a grant is unconstructable, declined, expired, revoked, missing required re-authentication, or materially mismatched, only the dependent delegated operation is withheld or degraded, never blocking the person, closing the room, withdrawing unrelated functionality or gating a right, with refusal content-free per ADR 0024. Grant and audit lifecycle records remain C0 governance metadata with no processing edges and must never become analytics, profiling, inference or scoring. Authentication is not consent, consent is not trust, trust is not truth, and a grant is never authority beyond its declared edge; available is not permitted, permitted is not true, fresh is not authorised and authorised is not fresh, and no runtime may collapse these into one ambient trusted or granted state. Deterministic obligations are separated from behavioural proof, and the pending grant-machinery stub remains pending. Authorises no implementation, runtime directory, software/package dependency, UI, authentication mechanism, session-manager implementation, model access, vendor-hosted access, payload construction, transmission mechanics, fixture execution, pending-ledger change, Lane C, W6 or W5-D2 milestone, and amends no record.

entries.title: 0031 — Payload Assembly and Payload Equality (DR-W5-04)
entries.role: Governs payload constructability, authorised assembly and payload equality for W5 runtime, the fourth of the seven W5-D1 doctrine records. A payload is the content and governed metadata assembled for one operation under one grant at one boundary, and it has no independent judgment: permission is not enough, and the assembled payload must match the authorised scope. A payload is lawful only if assembled from the exact authorised scope for the exact grant, matching its edge, actor, recipient or processing class, purpose, operation, duration, source zone, destination zone, plaintext status and vendor-involvement posture; the granted scope is the whole payload, in W1-D6's own words, and nothing may be added for helpfulness, safety, convenience, continuity, room coherence, model quality, SDK defaults or implementation ease. Forbidden inclusion is enumerated: SDK extras, device identifiers, helpful context, room state, conversation history beyond the grant, cross-room context, cached context, adjacent context, inferred enrichment, derived enrichment, system prompts or hidden instructions carrying user, room or content state beyond the grant, and anything included merely because it is already available; availability is not authorisation, enrichment may not be reintroduced as summarising or normalising, and a payload assembled from more than one grant is unconstructable. Metadata is permitted only where governed and required to enforce scope, freshness, authority, refusal, audit or equality, with authority labels, ADR-0029 freshness labels, grant identity, edge, purpose, operation, actor, recipient class, zones, plaintext status, vendor-involvement posture and content-free comparison metadata permitted, and device identifiers, SDK defaults, behavioural-profiling, room-state, user-scoring, authority-scoring, consent-pressure and ambient shadow-profile metadata barred absent a future governed record; metadata must never become hidden enrichment. No payload is assembled outside a user-initiated granted operation, and none is pre-assembled, warmed, speculatively built or retained for reuse. Payload equality means the authorised and displayed grant scope and the assembled or used payload are equal under the governed comparison form for that boundary: byte-level equality applies where applicable at the last controllable point, and where byte equality is not meaningful the comparison is canonical, structural, field-level and deterministic. Semantic similarity, intention-equivalence, output-equivalence, same-effect, same-visible-answer and close-enough never satisfy equality, and a difference in governed content, required metadata, authorised scope, boundary-relevant field or comparison surface does not become lawful because it is said not to matter; representation differences may be ignored only where the governed canonical comparison form says they are irrelevant, never by runtime discretion. Three comparisons are obligations: granted or displayed scope against assembled payload, assembled payload against the payload at the last controllable point, and pre-adapter against post-adapter payload where a transformation exists; equality binds at the last controllable point per boundary edge, not at assembly time alone, and beyond that point the Wing makes no claim about recipient behaviour. The local controllable payload boundary is governed now, which is the Z3 limb. Z4 remains dormant: the Z4 limb of the payload-equality obligation stays visibly pending, W5 may not claim the Z4 obligation discharged, E10 is not activated, no VendorAdapter ADR is authored or pre-empted, and no vendor-hosted access or vendor disclosure is authorised; the equality doctrine is written to be boundary-general so a future governed vendor boundary must satisfy it, which is not activation. A content-free comparison result or fingerprint may be recorded only if it reveals no payload content, becomes no processing edge, permits no reconstruction, is used only to prove equality, refusal, lifecycle or audit discipline, and remains C0 governance metadata; no hash function, storage field, schema, table, index, retention period or query mechanism is prescribed, and a fingerprint is never a substitute for the prohibition. ADR-0029 labels travel with content where required and freshness never justifies payload expansion: fresh is not authorised and authorised is not fresh. Where payload equality cannot be proven the dependent delegated operation does not proceed, unproven is not presumed-equal, the refusal is structural and content-free and writes no user, room, profile or vault state, only the dependent operation is withheld or degraded, never blocking the person, closing the room, gating a right or withdrawing unrelated lawful functionality, and a refusal is never resolved by narrowing the proof. Deterministic obligations are separated from behavioural proof, which remains DR-W5-07 and W5-D3 to W5-D4's. This record is a prerequisite for the pending payload-equality test and does not unblock it, because the live condition also requires that an assembler exists and because the Z4 limb remains pending; no pending-ledger change, stub conversion or test enablement follows. Boundaries against DR-W5-05 transmission and disclosure mechanics, DR-W5-06 model access and DR-W5-07 behavioural evaluation are preserved. Authorises no implementation, runtime directory, software/package dependency, payload assembler, serialisation format, canonicalisation algorithm, hash function, comparison mechanism, schema, table, index, storage mechanism, UI, copy catalogue, model access, vendor-hosted access, transmission mechanics, actual disclosure, E10 activation, VendorAdapter ADR, fixture execution, pending-ledger change, Lane C, W6 or W5-D2 milestone, and amends no record.

entries.title: 0032 — Transmission and Disclosure Mechanics (DR-W5-05)
entries.role: Governs transmission and disclosure mechanics for W5 runtime, the fifth of the seven W5-D1 doctrine records. Grant permitted, payload equality proved and transmission authorised are three separate gates, and this record governs the third only: a lawful grant does not assemble a payload, a lawful payload does not authorise transmission, and payload equality does not authorise crossing. There is no ambient transmission authority, and no granted, trusted, authenticated or session-active flag may stand in for a proved gate. Transmission means any deliberate movement, presentation, handoff, send, export delivery, adapter handoff, model call, vendor call or metadata-bearing transfer by which payload content or governed payload metadata crosses from the Wing's controlled processing context into a distinct recipient, recipient class, file or export artefact, adapter, model, service, vendor, log, telemetry channel or other boundary context; naming a category as transmission does not activate that category. Disclosure occurs when payload content, governed payload metadata or a content-derived representation becomes visible, available, inspectable, retained, transmitted to or processable by a recipient or recipient class outside the authorised internal assembly context, and is broader than external network send. The recipient class must be nameable, inspectable and matched to the grant, a crossing whose recipient cannot be named is refused, and a transmission to a different recipient, class, adapter, service, model, vendor, log or telemetry channel is unconstructable or refused, with no hidden recipient expansion and no fan-out under one grant; source zone, destination zone, plaintext status and vendor-involvement posture must each match the grant at the moment of crossing. W1-D5 OR-2 is carried unsoftened: the Wing cannot verify vendor retention behaviour from outside, the mitigation is disclosure honesty rather than technical control, and claims of verified deletion, guaranteed non-retention, technical retention control, privacy by transit encryption, contractual safety, harmlessness by SDK convention, non-disclosure by automation, or control after boundary crossing are barred; if the Wing cannot prove recipient behaviour it must not claim it, and no comfort language may soften an honest sentence. W1-D2 section 4's disclosure form is fixed and binding and is restated and operationalised here, never redesigned, softened, narrowed or improved; the sentence must match the actual crossing rather than the intended one, and exact wording, localisation and catalogue form remain W6's. The last controllable point is ADR-0031's and is carried forward unchanged, and beyond it the Wing makes no claim about recipient behaviour. A refused or aborted attempt creates a content-free governance and refusal event only if nothing crossed; if anything crossed before the abort the crossing is a disclosure event recorded honestly, a partial crossing is a crossing, and a failed outcome never retroactively unmakes an exposure. A retry, resumption, duplicate send or replay is a new transmission attempt unless mechanically proven identical in grant, recipient or recipient class, payload-equality proof, boundary, plaintext posture, vendor posture and user-authorised operation; silent resend, background retry, retry after expiry or revocation, and any retry changing recipient, payload, governed metadata, posture or purpose are barred. Logging, telemetry, diagnostics, SDK defaults, crash reports, traces, analytics, monitoring and error reporting are possible transmission and disclosure surfaces and are not exempt because they are operational; content-bearing or content-derived telemetry is disclosure, metadata-only telemetry can be disclosure where it carries governed metadata, identity, sensitivity class, room or person linkage or reconstruction risk, and SDK defaults create no authority. Metadata-only transfer can be disclosure and the absence of a content body is not a safe harbour. A disclosure or governance record may contain a content-free comparison result or fingerprint only if it reveals no payload content, becomes no processing edge, permits no reconstruction, is used only for equality, refusal, lifecycle, audit or disclosure accountability, and remains C0 governance metadata; no hash function, storage field, schema, table, index, retention period, query mechanism or event-store design is prescribed, and no disclosure record contains payload content. entries.title: 0038 — Display-Vocabulary and Label Law
entries.role: The first W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-01), carrying the accepted brief's laws one to three. The display vocabulary is closed at seven exhaustive classes — source-state labels shown verbatim or through registered derived labels and never through invented synonyms; derived presentation labels computed at presentation by recorded deterministic rules and never stored, generalising the Lane C derived-never-stored precedent Wing-wide; routing labels that name destinations never judgements; non-authority labels as first-class load-bearing content including the mandatory executed-is-not-passed accompaniment; review labels always attributed to human review; prohibition labels permitted only in negation form; and future-owned labels that say dormant when a thing is dormant. Renaming a stored state into a safer-looking display alias is minting authority by thesaurus and is barred; explanatory prose is bounded by its sources. The prohibited-label law closes a barred display list — including passed, safe, clinically safe, medically safe, legally satisfied, production-ready, approved by the system, validated as correct, behaviourally proven, proof of safety, diagnosis, therapy, treatment advice, readiness, all-green status, success verdict, and every word formed from the certif- and complian- stems — growable by record and never shrinkable, consumable as data with the deterministic validation obligation landing when the first string-bearing artefact exists. The prohibited-visual law binds the visual axioms — a rendered word is a claim, colour is a sentence, a checkmark is a verdict, omission of an honest state is an overclaim — and bars six checkable visual classes: verdict glyphs on execution, evidence or applicability states; grading colour semantics; aggregate verdicts and readiness meters; concealment groupings that hide deferred, unknown, not-evidenced or unresolved states; ceremony-bypassing affordances including any bulk-approve control; and confidence by prominence — with future rendering artefacts obliged to declare glyph, colour, coverage and affordance inventories as data so the bans check deterministically. Every known honest state family is assigned its vocabulary class and none may be omitted from a surface that shows its siblings. Creates no catalogue, allocates no identifier, renders nothing, grades nothing, changes no governed state anywhere, and leaves detailed per-state rendering to DR-W6-02, delta presentation to DR-W6-03, the firewall to DR-W6-04 which consumes this record whole, catalogue identity to DR-W6-05, and the surface contract to DR-W6-06. W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0039 — The Label-Authority Firewall
entries.role: The second W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-04) and the keystone of the surface era: the label-authority firewall, translating passing-tests-must-not-mint-authority to presentation under one normative formula — display may preserve source authority; display may not create authority. Consumes ADR-0038 whole and unweakened as its input layer, with any conflict resolved in ADR-0038's favour. Binds the firewall as a mechanism of eleven checkable binds: the closed display vocabulary, class-as-data, the authority-non-increasing derivation rule (verbatim or registered deterministic derivation whose output never carries more certainty, approval or finality than its input — the Lane C overlay derivation the founding member), prohibited wording and stem checks, prohibited visual declaration checks over declared glyph, colour, coverage and affordance inventories, mandatory unweakened non-authority accompaniments, honest-state coverage with concealment failing as overclaim, no write-back of derived presentation states to any governed source, no ranking or prominence without a declared non-quality rule, no ceremony-bypassing affordance including any bulk-approve control, and no machine verdict structurally — a verdict may display only where a governed source holds a recorded human-authorised act, and no current W6 source holds one. Enforces the register distinctions: absence is not unknown, pending is not converted, evidenced asserts no requirement satisfied, executed is not passed. Twelve normative firewall rules bind every future display artefact, ending with the admission condition that an artefact unable to declare its labels, classes, derivations, visual semantics, coverage and affordances as data cannot pass. Deterministic conformance proofs land with the artefacts that first bear strings and surfaces, under DR-W6-05's catalogue validation and DR-W6-06's surface contract; until then nothing is checked and no conformance is claimed. The firewall promotes nothing: executed stays not passed, unknowns stay unknown, deferred stays deferred, unresolved stays unresolved, pending stays pending. Creates no catalogue, allocates no identifier, renders nothing, grades nothing, changes no governed state; W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0040 — Honest-State Rendering Law
entries.role: The third W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-02), carrying the accepted brief's laws four to nine: one worked rendering law per honest state, decided inside ADR-0038 (Parts A, B, E and F consumed) and ADR-0039 consumed whole under its formula that display may preserve source authority and may not create authority, with conflicts resolving upward and nothing consumed weakened. Unknown renders as a standing truth with its basis, never as absence, blank, error or work to clear — display resolves nothing, and omitting unknowns where siblings display is the concealment overclaim. Review-required renders as a route to human review with destination and status only — no verdict, no recommendation, no score, detailed delta presentation reserved to DR-W6-03. Deferred renders with its named dependency visible, never as failure, progress, completion or promise. behaviourally_executed renders as one governed run happened and nothing more, never as passed, tested, successful, correct, validated, proven or complete, with the executed-is-not-passed accompaniment mandatory, in reach and unabbreviated, and success-grouping barred by name. evidenced renders as an evidence pointer present with its citation, never as satisfied, approved, legally satisfied, or any word from the complian- or certif- stems, carrying the standing non-claim that evidence presence is not satisfaction. not_evidenced renders as honest absence with the same dignity as its siblings, never as failure, shame, alarm or a hidden state. Applicability-unresolved renders at full size as unresolved, never as not-applicable, dismissed or safe to ignore, with resolution remaining a future governed act no rendering may imply. Six mandatory non-authority accompaniments are fixed as one table; barred textual transformations are summarised as authority-by-thesaurus instances; barred visual forms consume V1 to V6 per state with visuals obeying every textual rule. DR-W6-03 consumes the routing boundary; DR-W6-05's validation and DR-W6-06's surface contract consume the accompaniment and barred-form sets as data-shaped obligations. Renders nothing, creates no catalogue, allocates no identifier, changes no governed state — the twenty-six unknowns stay unknown and the twenty-three executed fixtures stay not-passed; W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0041 — Human-Routing Presentation Law
entries.role: The fourth W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-03), carrying the accepted brief's laws ten to twelve: presentation law for human-routed material beyond the routing boundary ADR-0040 decision four fixed, consuming ADR-0038's routing and future-owned classes and V5, ADR-0039 whole with its no-machine-verdict and no-ceremony-bypassing binds, the pending ledger's no-bulk-approve obligation, the W5 evaluation posture and the closure carry-forward inventories, with conflicts resolving upward and nothing weakened. Review-routed deltas display whole — both variant captures exactly as the source records hold them with the fact and recorded reason of routing — and display never does the review: no recommendation, score, verdict, winner, better or safer option, no collapse of two variants into a machine-selected conclusion, and no hidden variant because there is no selected variant unless a human record later creates one; absent a human decision the state remains routed to human review, and time never escalates it. Pending stubs display with identity, owner, dependency and unblocking condition, as pending not converted, with no convert, approve, approve-all, resolve, retire or mark-done affordance of any kind, no bulk path by words, visuals, grouping or affordance, never grouped as defects or backlog shame and never hidden for being uncomfortable — display performs neither eligibility nor conversion. Carried open questions display as carried, still alive: never resolved, retired, irrelevant, ignored, not applicable, deferred forever or a roadmap promise, with the three waits — carried question, pending stub, deferred dependency — kept distinct and never merged into one open-items pile. The human-attribution chain is law: a human decision displays only where a governed source records a human act, attributed as human with its source cited; no current W6 record creates such an act; human-review-needed is not human-reviewed, routed-to-review is not reviewed, and reviewed is not approved unless the recorded act says approval and a future record authorises its display. Visual law bars verdict glyphs, urgency theatre, red-as-failure, green-as-cleared, progress bars over waits, concealment defaults and every ceremony-implying affordance. Five accompaniments complete the ADR-0040 table across all governed display states. Renders nothing, performs no review, invents no human act, converts nothing, retires nothing; W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0042 — Catalogue Identity and Catalogue-ID Namespace Law
entries.role: The fifth W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-05), carrying the accepted brief's law fourteen and gating W6-D2 without opening it. The governed string catalogue is defined as a governed register of approved display strings and their required metadata — each entry carrying string, vocabulary class, source authority, derivation reference, accompaniment linkage, prohibition register and proof obligations as data — and defined equally by what it is not: not a surface, UI, renderer, copy deck, glossary, design system, or softening translation layer, and never a source of authority, because registration lends a string nothing. Membership is governed strings only in the seven ADR-0038 classes including the ADR-0040 and ADR-0041 accompaniment tables as first-class members; exclusions bar source records, evidence, fixtures, evaluation results, human decisions except as later-law source-cited strings, layout, glyphs, colours, affordances, screenshots, runtime behaviour, model output, and anything that would create a surface by being registered. Catalogue-ID law: an ID identifies one governed string record and that is the whole of its meaning — stable, immutable except through visible supersession or retirement with identifiers never reused, encoding no ranking, quality, priority, risk, confidence, approval or order, implying no acceptance, safety, correctness, satisfaction, certif- or complian- form, diagnosis, therapy, production readiness or proof, never a verdict, never a substitute for source citation, and never authorising display by itself — necessary, never sufficient. The namespace is closed and mechanically checkable: a single flat CAT- prefixed allocation sequence under the register precedent, identity structurally separated from meaning with every meaning in fields, no sub-namespaces, and the single illustrative identifier marked non-final with nothing allocated. The thirty-three review-of-record strings are seed corpus only — not graded, not admitted, not renderable — with per-string admission or rejection through W6-D2's own brief and ceremony, rejection a lawful outcome. Thirteen deterministic obligations are specified for the dormant catalogue-ID validator class, which W6-D2 wakes by record and which today stays exactly a dormancy assertion, untouched. W6-D2 may open only after this record's publication, still requires its own accepted brief, and must prove declarability, per-entry validation, per-seed admission decisions and no authority-by-registration before any catalogue artefact exists. Creates no catalogue, file, schema, entry or ID; wakes nothing; grades nothing; renders nothing; W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0043 — Review-Surface Boundary Contract
entries.role: The sixth and final W6-D1 doctrine record (DR-W6-06), carrying the accepted brief's law fifteen and completing the W6-D1 doctrine set at its publication — doctrine complete is not capability begun, and W6-D2 becomes eligible for its own future accepted brief without being opened. A review surface is a bounded reader over governed sources and governed catalogue entries presented to a human — a presentation boundary, never an authority boundary: nothing becomes true by being shown. Sixteen non-identities held structurally: not a source of truth or authority, not a runtime, model, memory, cache, annotation store, decision store, workflow engine, approval, conversion or retirement system, human-review record, hidden ledger, fifth channel, or substitute for records or human acts. Read law: declared governed sources only, through what the boundary exposes; no discovery by path walk, search, heuristic, model inference or metadata sweep; no merging into unstated sources; no model output unless a future W7-era record creates such a source, and no W6 record does. Write law: a surface writes nothing and persists nothing — no derived labels, filters, selections, comments, annotations, decisions or display state — unless a future governed record creates a lawful store, and in W6-D1 none exists. State law: transient render-time state only if later authorised and proven non-persisting, with the four named drifts barred — no cache becoming a shadow source, no convenience state becoming evidence, no hidden queue becoming a workflow, no annotation field becoming a human decision. Channel law: there are no hidden channels and no fifth channel; a needed channel is new architecture and must stop for its own governed crossing record. Declarability law: fifteen declarations as data — sources, derivations, catalogue IDs, classes, accompaniments, visual semantics, glyphs, colours, coverage, filters, ordering, affordances, and write, persistence and external paths which are none unless later governed — under one admission rule: no declaration, no pass. The no-bulk-approve obligation is a contract term barring every batch and ceremony-collapsing affordance. The human-review boundary carries four aphorisms as contract terms: viewing is not reviewing, clicking is not deciding, selecting is not approving, closing a panel is not retiring — a surface may never create or record a human act. Twenty proof obligations are specified for future W6-D4 surfaces in the W5 same-commit style, as specifications only. Consumes ADR-0038 V4/V5, declarations, classes and vocabulary, ADR-0039 whole, ADR-0040 decisions three to twelve, ADR-0041 decisions three to fifteen, ADR-0042's identity and gate law, the ledger's no-bulk-approve, and ADR-0024's observation-never-a-second-channel as precedent, weakening nothing. Creates no surface, cache, store, workflow or path; renders nothing; changes no governed state; W6-D2 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: 0044 — Catalogue Artefact Shape and Home
entries.role: The first landing of the W6-D2 five-landing plan (W6-D2-A): the decision record for the future governed string catalogue artefact's home, format, registry posture and declarability posture — deciding where and in what shape the catalogue will one day live while creating none of it: no file, no schema, no entry, no CAT identifier final or illustrative, no seed admission, no validator wake, no rendering. Home: governance/string-catalogue.json — a single artefact beside the registry it structurally mirrors, governance-visible by nature, atomic as one file, one hash, one diff, following the registry's own single-governed-JSON-register precedent. Format: JSON under the standing repository data conventions — UTF-8, no BOM, LF, lower_snake_case, indented for line-oriented diffs — chosen for deterministic parse, record-granular diffs, direct validator consumption with no extraction step, and structural room for every ADR-0042 decision-two field as data, with key order, record layout and every schema field remaining W6-D2-B's. Registry posture: registered with content hash under its own entry, created by the same authorised landing that first creates the file, hash and bytes born and moving together — registration providing integrity tracking only, never display authority, never acceptance of entries, never proof of wording quality, with the identity-versus-authority separation preserved: a catalogue file existing, registered and hashing correctly cannot authorise the display of one word. Declarability posture: the artefact must satisfy ADR-0039 rule twelve about itself, able to declare every required catalogue-record field as data and remain mechanically checkable whole by the future W6-D2-C validator — capability named, fields not created. Markdown-under-docs rejected for extraction fragility and the runway's named copy-deck drift risk; the split machine-plus-generated-documentation model deferred as premature with any future generated view derived read-only and never a second source; the Lane C JSON-inside-Markdown pattern assessed and rejected for a pure register. entries.title: 0045 — Catalogue Schema and Metadata Shape
entries.role: The second landing of the W6-D2 five-landing plan (W6-D2-B): the schema-shape decision record, defining the future catalogue's JSON shape in doctrine inside ADR-0044's fixed and unreopened inputs, creating no file, no standalone schema artefact, no entry, and no identifier final or illustrative — the record itself is the schema's single authoritative statement, with a second schema artefact rejected as a second source of truth. Top level: a single JSON object with four keys in canonical order — catalogue_version, status with birth value governed_register_active, a byte-stable governance_note worded at first population, and entries born empty and populated only by W6-D2-D's per-string decisions — the registry's own version-note-entries pattern followed. Entry shape: a flat array, each entry all eleven fields always with no omitted keys and no hidden defaults, sorted by id in allocation order which encodes nothing; grouping by class rejected as semantic hierarchy, grouping by room rejected as surface information architecture smuggled into storage which would render the Meditation zero as a permanent empty section, and normalisation rejected as hidden joins. Canonical key order: id, string, vocabulary_class, source_authority, derivation_reference, accompaniment_linkage, prohibition_register, source_citation_requirement, supersession_retirement_posture, proof_obligations, display_authorisation_statement — identity first, the governed wording second, its law after, the ceiling last. Field law: id a lawfully allocated CAT value encoding nothing; string the exact governed wording never a paraphrase; vocabulary_class one of a closed seven-value machine set tied one-to-one to ADR-0038; source_authority a non-empty citation array with no-source-no-entry and source never display authority; derivation_reference null-or-citation to a registered authority-non-increasing rule with unregistered derivation inexpressible; accompaniment_linkage citation-based before allocation with emptiness lawful only where no law applies and validator-cross-checked; prohibition_register the single gate under which barred words and the certif- and complian- stems may lawfully appear in a string; source_citation_requirement a two-value checked legal fact never optional where law requires; supersession_retirement_posture a structured object with active birth value, visible supersession and retirement by record only, no silent edit, no deletion-as-cleanup, no id reuse; proof_obligations a non-empty array from a closed seven-token set where obligations are debts not receipts; and display_authorisation_statement one fixed verbatim ceiling sentence byte-identical in every entry so no record can be read or excerpted without its boundary. Exactly two fields nullable with defined meanings; absence always an error. Complete validation specification handed to W6-D2-C and the admission schema handed to W6-D2-D with nothing admitted, nothing rejected, rejection lawful. The catalogue remains uncreated; W6-D3 through W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.role: The opening landing of the W6-D4 programme, merging A, B and C with the justification in place: the reviewable unit is the complete surface framework before anything renders, with the build kept separate. Opens W6-D4 for brief-governed work only, asking exactly whether the words can be shown without minting authority, consuming ADR-0043 whole and binding seven named risks at opening — viewing becoming review, clicking becoming decision, selecting becoming approval, closing becoming retirement, ordering becoming priority, filtering becoming concealment, and prominence becoming authority — each made structural by the chosen medium. Carries the state-family rendering directive whole: rendering law reasoned once per genuinely shared family, tied to ADR-0040 and ADR-0041, with a mandatory per-item trace row for every rendered item carrying source, catalogue entry, governed state, accompaniment linkage, rendered wording, proof result and non-authority confirmation — a family proof is explanatory, the per-item trace is mandatory. Decides the medium: a static generated review surface at docs/surface/review-surface.html, produced deterministically by a Python-stdlib-only generator with no JavaScript, no forms, no interactive controls and no external references, accompanied by a declarations artefact carrying the ADR-0043 fifteen declarations as data and a complete per-item trace artefact — documentation-only rejected as answering the question only in theory, a preview server rejected as a runtime surface, CLI preview rejected as unreviewable, richer media premature behind their own future briefs. Implementation is permitted inside the merged D+E+F landing under this medium. Scope: the full governed string register with D3 dispositions and their ceilings, all sixty-five Lane C rows, the whole evaluation posture with both variant captures whole, all nine pending stubs with no affordance, and the carried open questions — total coverage, with omission the V4 overclaim. Registry posture explicit: the three generated artefacts deliberately excluded for the evaluation-records reason, integrity proven by deterministic byte-identical regeneration. The exposure contract closes the read set at six declared inputs with undeclared input failing structurally — no path walk, search, metadata sweep, source merge, hidden source, cache, store, environment, network or clock — and binds the source-trace requirement to every rendered row with a two-way rendered-traced bijection. Nothing renders at this landing; W6-D5, W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: W6-D4-D/E/F — Surface Materialisation and Structural Proof Record

The static review surface exists: a dependency-free deterministic generator reading exactly the six declared inputs of the exposure contract with undeclared access refusing structurally, emitting one HTML artefact with no JavaScript, no forms, no controls, no links, no external references, no verdict glyphs and a provably neutral grey palette encoding nothing, plus the ADR-0043 fifteen declarations as data with empty glyph, affordance, write, persistence and external inventories, plus the mandatory per-item trace of one hundred and eighty-eight rows — thirty-three register entries, sixty-five evidence rows, twenty-three executed fixtures, twenty-six honest unknowns, twenty-five routed deltas with both variant captures whole, nine pending stubs and seven carried questions — each row carrying source, catalogue id where applicable, governed state, accompaniment, rendered wording, proof result and non-authority confirmation, under Tara's directive that family reasoning is explanatory and the per-item trace is the accountability. Twenty-six structural proofs land in the same commit: bounded clockless imports, no discovery, write paths exactly two, byte-identical regeneration as the integrity mechanism, trace bijection both ways, accompaniments and aphorisms and ceilings rendered inline, uncomfortable states at full size, no barred affirmative anywhere, no display-authorisation claim, and artefacts living only under docs/surface. entries.title: W6-D4-G — Review Surfaces Closure Record
entries.role: The final landing of the W6-D4 programme: the closure record, landing separately after the materialisation was published and independently reviewable. W6-D4 — Review Surfaces — is complete and closed: three landings with every merge justification stated in its record, and closure changes nothing. Exactly one surface exists and it is exactly one kind — a static generated review surface with its declarations and its mandatory per-item trace, produced deterministically by a standard-library-only generator reading exactly the six declared inputs with undeclared access refusing structurally. What it cannot do is everything else: no scripts, forms, controls, links or affordances; no write, cache, persistence, channel, workflow, approval, conversion, retirement or bulk path; no verdict, glyph, colour-as-state or claim — viewing it reviews nothing, decides nothing, approves nothing and retires nothing, structurally, because nothing on it can be pressed. Results final: one hundred and eighty-eight trace rows rendered and individually proven across register, evidence, evaluation, unknowns, routed deltas, stubs and carried questions; twenty-six structural proofs green in the materialisation commit including byte-identical regeneration and the two-way trace bijection; family reasoning used exactly as directed and replacing nothing; two named mechanical exceptions carried faithfully and proven bounded. W6-D5 is next and remains unopened; W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: W6-D5-A — Presentation Assurance Opening Brief
entries.role: The opening landing of the W6-D5 programme, opening the deliverable for brief-governed assurance work only and asking exactly whether the showing stayed honest. Names the audited baseline as clean: the static review surface with its declarations and one-hundred-and-eighty-eight-row trace, twenty-six structural proofs green, and the published Tier M erratum reconciling the materialisation record's proof-count wording to the live suite — a baseline this audit reads and does not alter. Defines the sequence as four landings: this opening; the audit execution merging the rendered-state, implied-claim, trace and pending-stub work as one read-only session over one artefact set; the findings consolidation separately; and the closure posture separately after the findings are published and independently reviewable, kept apart deliberately because where an audit records anything correction-needed the findings must be visible before completeness is declared over them. Carries the standing audit directive: state-family reasoning only where a rule is genuinely shared and tied to its source authority, with every rendered item, trace row and stub finding audited individually and published as its own row — family reasoning explains, the per-item row answers, and no shared rule may excuse an individual mismatch, omission, overclaim, visual implication, trace drift or source contradiction from being found and named. Binds six risks at opening: rendered-state drift, visual semantics minting authority including the silence of a page without controls, trace mismatch in either direction, omission overclaim audited against sources rather than the page's own contents, catalogue-display confusion, and pending-stub conversion by implication with eligible distinguished from converted and nothing converted. States that D5 assurance is not certification, safety, production readiness, clinical validity, legal conformance, correctness or approval — a clean audit says only that the presentation remained faithful to its sources on the checks performed, on the day performed. Audits nothing, records no finding, classifies nothing, corrects nothing: any correction found necessary is named and never made, its smallest governed path proposed and execution waiting for its own authorisation. W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: W6-D5-B/C/D/E — Presentation Assurance: Audit Execution
entries.role: The audit-execution landing of the W6-D5 programme, merging the rendered-state, implied-claim, trace and pending-stub work as one read-only session over one artefact set, with the findings and closure landings kept separate so anything correction-needed is visible before completeness is declared. Five hundred and thirty-one checks executed against the live artefacts and their governed sources, recomputing derivations independently rather than trusting the surface's own claims, and altering nothing. Rendered-state audit: one hundred and eighty-eight of one hundred and eighty-eight match, no drift, no omission, no softened state, every uncomfortable state at full size. Implied-claim audit: fourteen satisfied, one observation, no defects — colour neutral and declared, no glyph, no success or completion language, no aggregate, score or rating in the rendered body, no control, form, script or link, the page's own silence carrying the four aphorisms so the absence of controls cannot read as review having happened, one typographic register, no filter or collapse, ordering declared and non-quality-named. Trace audit: three hundred and twenty-one of three hundred and twenty-four match, with the trace complete and bijective both ways, all seven mandatory fields present per row, every catalogue id mapping to its governed entry with wording identity, both ceilings rendered, and state-family reasoning demonstrably not replacing individual accountability. Two findings stand, neither a current misstatement and both accountability-path risks: the per-entry grading disposition renders from a generator literal whose content is accurate and citation-supported but would not follow a future grading change, and the four applicability records render as an accurate family statement without the individual rows every other governed state carries. Two observations recorded as not findings. W6-owned stubs: three identified, none converted, ledger byte-identical, eligibility distinguished from conversion. The audit performed no certification, safety validation, legal-conformance assessment, clinical validation, production-readiness assessment or approval, and corrected nothing; W6-D6 and W7 remain unopened.

entries.title: W6-D5-F — Assurance Findings and Correction Paths
entries.role: The findings landing of the W6-D5 programme, consolidating the published audit evidence into classified findings with the smallest governed correction path named for each and every correction stopped unexecuted, landing separately from closure so anything correction-needed is visible before completeness is declared over it. Answers the programme question: the showing stayed honest on the checks performed, on the day performed — no rendered state drifted, no honest state was omitted, softened, aggregated away or hidden, nothing in words, colours, ordering, prominence or silence implied approval, completion, safety, correctness, conformance or readiness, and state-family reasoning excused no item from answering for itself — with that finding bounded exactly: it is not certification, safety, clinical validity, legal conformance, correctness, production readiness or approval. entries.title: W6-D5-G — Presentation Assurance Closure Record
entries.role: The final landing of the W6-D5 programme: the closure record, landing after the framework, the evidence and the findings were each published and independently reviewable. W6-D5 — Presentation Assurance — is complete and closed because the deliverable's own obligations are discharged, not because everything the audit found is resolved: two correction-needed findings remain open by design, visible, sized, unexecuted and awaiting their own authorisation, because an assurance deliverable that quietly repaired what it found would destroy the independent account it exists to produce. The programme ran as four landings with F and G deliberately kept apart so the findings were reviewable before completeness was declared over them. Carries the audit's answer to closure: the showing stayed honest on the checks performed — one hundred and eighty-eight of one hundred and eighty-eight rendered states matching their sources, fourteen implied-claim checks satisfied with no defects, three hundred and twenty-one of three hundred and twenty-four trace and mapping checks matching with the trace bijective both ways and every row carrying all seven mandatory fields, and state-family reasoning proven not to have replaced individual accountability — bounded in the same breath as not certification, safety, clinical validity, legal conformance, correctness, production readiness or approval. Lists outstanding items at closure: both correction-needed findings open with their smallest paths named and untaken, the optional audit-as-proof-module path open by choice, the three W6-owned stubs eligible for future consideration with none converted and the ledger byte-identical, and two observations closed. Confirms every audited artefact, source and ledger byte-identical to its pre-D5 state — the deliverable read them and wrote nothing. W6-D6 is next and remains unopened, inheriting the open findings as named, unresolved, honestly-carried work; W7 remains unopened.

entries.role: The opening landing of the W6-D6 programme, opening the deliverable for brief-governed phase-closure work only and authorising the preparation of a closure record and nothing else: no closure declared, no correction executed, no stub converted, W7 not opened. Inventories, assesses, reviews, logs, defers and closes nothing; executes no correction path; converts and edits no stub; mutates no artefact, source or ledger.

Declares no closure, executes no correction, converts no stub, and mutates no artefact, source, ledger or governed state.
